package.title: Medical, first aid and emergency preparedness (U.S. government sources)

rights_policy: Only U.S. federal government works (17 U.S.C. 105) in this package. Third-party material inside them is excluded where identified. Checked 2026-11-05; recheck before each release.

sources.title: MedlinePlus (NLM-written pages)
sources.rights_note: NLM-authored pages are public domain. A.D.A.M. encyclopedia (/ency/), ASHP drug monographs and Natural Medicines (/druginfo/) are licensed to NLM by third parties and are excluded. Genetics and lab-test sections are left out as out of scope.

sources.title: CDC Travelers' Health
sources.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.rights_note: CDC web content, public domain. The printed Yellow Book is published by Oxford University Press; only the online CDC text is used.

curation_policy: Passage exclusions and audience tags are content decisions recorded here with reasons. Each needs sign-off by a qualified clinician before a production release.
